name: Shao
caption: "𝐊𝐢𝐧𝐠 ♣️ - 𝑻𝒉𝒆 𝑪𝒉𝒊𝒄𝒌𝒆𝒏 𝑺𝒉𝒐𝒑 𝑩𝒐𝒔𝒔 𝒂𝒌𝒂 "𝑻𝒉𝒆 𝑪𝒐𝒍𝒐𝒏𝒆𝒍" The Feds are puzzled. Surely, this franchisee's a front for something? The freezers, the tills, the warm lighting... Everything's where they should be... "𝑻𝒉𝒆𝒊𝒓 𝒄𝒉𝒊𝒄𝒌𝒆𝒏'𝒔 𝒕𝒐 𝒅𝒊𝒆 𝒇𝒐𝒓! 𝑳𝒊𝒕𝒆𝒓𝒂𝒍𝒍𝒚!" "

name: Mun Yee
caption: "𝐀𝐜𝐞 ♠️ - 𝑻𝒉𝒆 𝑹𝒆𝒗𝒆𝒓𝒔𝒆 𝑨𝒓𝒄𝒉𝒊𝒕𝒆𝒄𝒕 𝒂𝒌𝒂 "𝑻𝒉𝒆 𝑪𝒂𝒓𝒐𝒖𝒔𝒆𝒍𝒍𝒆𝒓" Reverse-engineers a building's design to find structural weaknesses, hidden passages, how to get in and out. Loves blueprints, probably."

name: Ping
caption: "𝐉𝐚𝐜𝐤 ♣️ - 𝑻𝒉𝒆 𝑾𝒉𝒆𝒆𝒍𝒎𝒂𝒏 𝒂𝒌𝒂 𝑭𝒓𝒆𝒅𝒅𝒊𝒆 𝒕𝒉𝒆 𝑪𝒂𝒓 Drop offs, quick escapes, understands the city traffic and layout, treats his car like a tamed monster. Zoom Zoom Kaboom!"

name: Steve
caption: "𝐊𝐢𝐧𝐠 ♦️- 𝑻𝒉𝒆 𝑴𝒐𝒏𝒆𝒚 He doesn't do the break in... it's not his style. But he knows what it costs to get in, what it costs to get out, and, with an unnerving precision, exactly what each person in this room would accept to betray the others."

name: Bing
caption: "𝐐𝐮𝐞𝐞𝐧 ♣️ - 𝑻𝒉𝒆 𝑰𝒏𝒇𝒐𝒓𝒎𝒂𝒏𝒕 Your unsuspecting bro who you can either find at the newspaper stand, beside the vending machine, or in the alleyway. Information? No problem."

name: Zul
caption: "𝐉𝐚𝐜𝐤 ♠️ - 𝑻𝒉𝒆 𝑸𝒖𝒂𝒓𝒕𝐞𝐫𝒎𝒂𝒔𝒕𝒆𝒓 𝒂𝒌𝒂 "𝑻𝒉𝒆 𝑪𝒍𝒆𝒂𝒏𝒆𝒓" Heists are messy and I am good at cleaning up, give me your mess and I will make sure we leave squeaky clean. Just tip me well on the way out and keep my namecard hidden."

name: Michelle
caption: "𝐐𝐮𝐞𝐞𝐧 ♦️- 𝑻𝒉𝒆 Counterfeit Times are hard. She's unemployed, did a 2-day resin class, a 3D printing workshop, and is currently learning Photoshop on TikTok. She has drive and a will to learn. Need something imitated? PLEASE give her a call. If you squint, you'll see the resemblance. She will make sure you do. "

name: Shirin
caption: "𝐉𝐚𝐜𝐤 ❤️ - 𝑻𝒉𝒆 𝑨𝒄𝒄𝒆𝒏𝒕 𝑻𝒆𝒂𝒄𝒉𝒆𝒓 She's undercover yet again... but she's never been that good at it... through a series of misunderstandings, she isn't aware of how inefficient her disguising and sleuthing is because her plans always seem to pan out somehow"

name: Nat
caption: "𝐊𝐢𝐧𝐠 ♠️- 𝑻𝒉𝒆 𝑨𝒄𝒄𝒐𝒖𝒏𝒕𝒂𝒏𝒕 As sirens echo throughout the city, he proves a VLOOKUP isn't the only thing he excels in, quietly killing the entire paper trail with a single, ruthless CTRL + Z."

name: Chris
caption: "𝐊𝐢𝐧𝐠 ❤️ - 𝑻𝒉𝒆 𝑺𝒘𝒆𝒆𝒕 𝑻𝒂𝒍𝒌𝒆𝒓 Working at Sweettalk and acting Koi. Rather share than having Each a Cup. Always choosing Lihos over bros. Can you be my playmade?"

name: Monil
desc: The Suit / DINK (Dual Identity No Kids)
caption: "𝐐𝐮𝐞𝐞𝐧 ❤️ - 𝑻𝒉𝒆 𝑺𝒖𝒊𝒕 𝒂𝒌𝒂 𝑫𝑰𝑵𝑲 (𝑫𝒖𝒂𝒍 𝑰𝒅𝒆𝒏𝒕𝒊𝒕𝒚 𝑵𝒐 𝑲𝒊𝒅𝒔) Already on the inside. Works for 'The Man', but screws them constantly. Everyone trusts and loves The Suit, but knows nothing about him. Gets away with any lie, so much so that it sometimes becomes the truth. (𝕸𝖆𝖓𝖎𝖋𝖊𝖘𝖙𝖆𝖙𝖎𝖔𝖓𝖘??)"

name: Xuemin
caption: "𝐀𝐜𝐞 ♦️- 𝕋ℍ𝔼 ℙ𝕆ℙ𝕊𝕋𝔸ℝ A walking disco ball has no business in the underworld. But a heist can only succeed with the perfect misdirection which might come in the form of a swoonworthy Getai singer or winner of Singapore Got Talent 2012."

name: Josh
caption: "𝐀𝐜𝐞 ❤️ - 𝑻𝒉𝒆 𝑴𝒂𝒅 𝑰𝒏𝒗𝒆𝒏𝒕𝒐𝒓 Lit in a dark workshop by the sparks of a soldering iron, industrial strength light sticks, and some LED strips he bought on Taobao. He handles all equipping and gadget-based problem solving, and always wants the others to try out his dangerous experimental inventions - after all, fellow thieves make the best test subjects!"

name: Darren
caption: "𝐐𝐮𝐞𝐞𝐧 ♠️ - 𝑻𝒉𝒆 𝑨𝒏𝒈𝒍𝒆𝒓 Every crew's got muscle, wheels, and a face. The Angler doesn't break in — he gets them to open the door. Everybody wants something, and has something they're willing to trade. Don't catch fish with a gun — find the right bait and they'll hook themselves. It's all angles."
